units.source_text: 他说：“让我来替小姐剪发。”

en.t: He said, "Let me cut the young lady's hair."

units.source_text: 拿起剪刀，又说：“好浓密啊！

en.t: He picked up the scissors and said again, "How thick it is!

units.source_text: 将来不知要长得多长呢！”

en.t: I wonder how long it will grow in the future!"
He felt he hardly knew where to begin.

units.source_text: 又说：“头发无论怎样长的人，额上的总是稍短些。

en.t: Then he said, "No matter how long a person's hair is, the hair over the forehead is always a little shorter.

units.source_text: 但如果都是短的而没有长些的拢到后边，便太缺乏情味了。”

en.t: But if it is all short and there is no longer hair to gather toward the back, it loses too much charm."

units.source_text: 剪好之后祝道：“郁郁青青，长过千寻！”

en.t: After he finished cutting it, he offered a blessing: "May it grow lush and green, longer than a thousand fathoms!"

units.source_text: 紫姬的乳母少纳言听了这祝词，深感欣幸。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's nurse, Shonagon, heard this blessing and felt deeply pleased.
